title: Catch the star
summary: Fly a bird with the arrow keys and catch a star five times.

steps.text: Add a star: press [[Sprites]] under the stage and choose Star.
Select the bird. Make it fly with the arrow keys: from Events drag “when game starts”, then from Motion drag “control sprite with arrows” into it.
Run it. Click the stage and use the arrow keys. Can you reach the star?
When the bird overlaps the star, add 1 to the score and move the star somewhere random.
Show the score: when the game starts, set the score to 0 and show it on the screen.
Win! When the game starts, wait until the score is 5, then finish the game as a win.
Play your game and catch five stars.

remix: Make the star glide away from the bird when it gets close.
Add a 20 second countdown so you must hurry.
Paint your own bird: select it and press [[Paint]] under the stage.
